user.title: Area Events app
user.description: Open the Area Events app in Settings > Apps, copy its hostname from the Info tab (it looks like abc12345-area-events) and the token you set in its Configuration tab.

data_description.token: The same token as in the app's configuration.

reauth_confirm.title: Token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The Area Events app rejected the token. Enter the token from the app's configuration.

error.cannot_connect: The app could not be reached. Check that it is running and that the address is correct.

abort.already_configured: This app is already set up.
